source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade FPGA firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade FPGA firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + FPGA image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- FPGA upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided FPGA image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the FPGA flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with host must be powered off first; an AC cycle is required after flash completes; after completion verify the FPGA version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the FPGA version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: FPGA firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; AC cycle after flash is mandatory; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Upgrade and downgrade FPGA firmware through the BMC WebUI with the host off, then perform the source-required AC cycle to activate the image and verify FPGA plus platform recovery.
original_method: An engineer selects/commits each FPGA image in WebUI, observes terminal flash state, executes one approved AC-cycle plan after completion, and verifies active FPGA version, BMC access, host POST/OS and logs.
manual_activity: The source requires attended WebUI image selection/commit/progress acceptance; an engineer also controls any physical hand-off required by the approved AC-cycle mechanism.
required_inputs: Exact FPGA device/board and current/upgrade/downgrade image hashes
Vendor WebUI programming and post-AC activation procedure
Host-off/BMC-standby definition and AC controller/off-on dwell/count
Active FPGA readback plus BMC/host health expectations
Known-good image, console/OOB and recovery path
safety_requirements: Bind the image to the exact FPGA/board revision before upload; do not infer compatibility from filename.
Keep host-off and BMC-standby state distinct from the later source-required AC cycle.
Do not generalize Seq 182: this row says AC cycle, not physical cable removal; use the approved project method.
Never retry, reverse or repeat the AC cycle after uncertainty; preserve WebUI, power, SEL and console evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare image/device identity and baseline evidence; monitor approved power telemetry and logs; collect independent post-AC FPGA inventory and BMC/host health.
Do not perform or claim the manual WebUI core, and do not set the engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve/perform each WebUI transition and exact AC-cycle hand-off.
Confirm FPGA activation and full platform recovery, then issue direction-specific verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It correctly preserves host-off and AC activation, but browser driving cannot replace manual WebUI acceptance and clean-single-reset is not a source criterion.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI manually and the approved AC-cycle controller; validate the existing IPMI raw version field against this FPGA before accepting it.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The host-off state, FPGA WebUI, mandatory AC cycle, script and 5/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED HOST-OFF FPGA UPDATE WITH CONTROLLED AC ACTIVATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind a signed image to the exact FPGA device, capture WebUI terminal state, execute one approved AC cycle with telemetry, then independently verify the active FPGA/version and BMC/host POST/OS/SEL health.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: BMC/FPGA combinations whose WebUI update requires AC activation with the host initially off.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board/FPGA image, BMC/WebUI/browser, readback script and AC controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor FPGA WebUI programming, AC activation and recovery documentation plus project power SOP.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact device binding, distinct pre-flash versus activation power states, validated readback and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Proves active post-AC programmable logic and platform recovery rather than only a WebUI banner.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved FPGA transition and AC-cycle plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Different FPGA revisions may share vague inventory labels; readback must uniquely identify the programmed device.

project_override_considerations: Projects may set images, transition order, AC mechanism/dwell/count and health checks. Completion is limited to that device and plan; it does not imply physical cable removal or another FPGA target.
expected_evidence: Approved FPGA/board/image transition matrix and hashes
Manual WebUI image selection, confirmation, progress and terminal state
Post-AC active FPGA identity/version, BMC reachability and host POST/OS health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires an FPGA WebUI flash with host off and an AC cycle after completion. Exact device/images/power timing are project inputs; the historical clean-single-reset phrase is rejected.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Target and lifecycle are understandable. Missing project values do not create permanent BLOCKED; attended WebUI core makes this MANUAL ONLY.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps host-off/AC scope but rejects browser substitution and unsupported reset wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains power/recovery controls and changes BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY under V3.1 project-input rules.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates pre-flash host-off state from AC activation and applies Seq 182 only to its case.

review_improvement: Makes FPGA device identity and post-AC activation independently observable while retaining the source's manual WebUI boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a coherent destructive lifecycle once the project selects an exact FPGA and AC plan. The WebUI action and observation remain core manual acceptance; automation can only support preparation, telemetry and post-cycle evidence.
